entries.label: Number slider
entries.whenToUse: Continuous numeric values: scale, speed, angle, spacing, intensity with a wide range.
entries.whenNotToUse: Avoid for pure 0–1 intensity (use number.unitInterval) or discrete modes (use enum.*).

entries.label: Unit interval (0–1)
entries.whenToUse: Normalized intensities, opacities, mix amounts, glow strength.
entries.whenNotToUse: Avoid for angles, pixel sizes, or counts.

entries.label: On/off switch
entries.whenToUse: Feature toggles: glitch enable, scanlines, vignette, show cursor.
entries.whenNotToUse: Avoid for play/pause of the main animation (use boolean.playPause).

entries.label: Color
entries.whenToUse: Palette colors: bg, ink, accent, glyph, fill.
entries.whenNotToUse: Avoid for theme packs that should set several colors at once (use enum.presetGrid + branch).

entries.label: Single-line text
entries.whenNotToUse: Avoid for multiline kerning pairs or long scripts (use text.textarea).

entries.label: Multiline text
entries.whenToUse: Kerning pairs, multi-line copy, structured free text.

entries.label: Segmented enum (≤4)
entries.whenToUse: 2–4 discrete visual modes the user toggles often.
entries.whenNotToUse: Avoid when options > 4 (use enum.select) or theme grids (enum.presetGrid).

entries.label: Select enum (5+)
entries.whenToUse: 5+ discrete modes, animation modes, character sets.

entries.label: Preset grid (themes)
entries.whenToUse: Named theme/look packs (Matrix, C64, Neon). Codegen must branch or map options to colors.
entries.whenNotToUse: Avoid for binary choices or continuous values.

entries.label: Image asset slot
entries.whenNotToUse: Avoid when the tool has no external image.
